text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
You've become "one year older"
than Neo Universe now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
During her vacation, Neo Universe read books.
She went to the planetarium, looked at the fixed stars at night—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Before you know it, it's 'today'—
that's the 'Urashima Effect' for you."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that "sub-lightspeed" experience... I'd love to try it again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Neo Universe enjoyed her day off
so much that it flew by in the blink of an eye.
